race.description: Vale And Congrats Jimmy-Biscuits Himmelhoch Hcp (Bm52)
race.comment: STEELY HUSTLER (10) showed a bit more third up at St Arnaud last week when finishing just over a length from the winner over 1200m. The extra 100m will help her, and Dean Yendall sticks with her, which is a positive. This is her chance to break her winning drought. KNOCK OF BEERS (5) finished close up in her penultimate start, and then plodded on at Kilmore last time out. Her only win came over this trip, and from a good gate, she can figure in the finish. RUNWAY RULER (4) has recently changed stables again, and her jump-out form has been solid after losing all form at the back end of last season. Linda Meech picks up the ride, which should help negate the wide gate, and the pair merits healthy respect. Value top 4 play. EVERETT (7) resumes from a spell, and her recent jump-out was satisfactory. She is likely to be running on, and if they overdo it up front, she can run into the money. GARGANTUAN (3) has a recent win at the picnics, and in this field, he is worth keeping safe.
